_comment: The 1.8.0 token and call ceilings (plan section 4), fixed at the start of W2 before any 1.8.0 token work. Read by `python -m benchmarks.token_suite --budget benchmarks/token_budget.json` and `python -m benchmarks.call_budget`. Edit a ceiling only with the measurement that justifies it, in the item that owns the cell.
token_method: ratio/v1: characters / the per-format divisor of benchmarks/token_suite.py (json_schema 4.19); estimates, not tokenizer counts. Characters are the measured unit.

gates.ci: Checked on every PR by --budget: a measurement over its ceiling exits 1.
gates.release: Over its ceiling on this tree, with a later owner named. --budget reports it under over_ceiling (never as a pass) and exits 0; --budget --release exits 1 on it, as does a release cell that is still unmeasured. The owner flips the cell to ci when its ceiling is met.
gates.growth: Every idle row on the headline basis, and the instructions row, may not grow more than growth_limit_pct over the published report: exit 1 on every PR.

v1.7.0_readme_wire._note: Copied from the README token table (token_suite idle lane, wire basis, measured for 1.7.0).

v1.7.0_measured._note: The cells the plan marked 'to measure', measured on the v1.7.0 tag (git archive v1.7.0, its own benchmarks/token_suite.py idle lane, run with this branch's frozen venv; TOOL_PACKS=core for packs_core). The wire values re-measure 0.1-0.3 % above the README's: same tree, newer lock.

w2_start_measured._note: The same measurement on release/1.8.0 after the W1 integration (41588a8), before any 1.8-14 change: W1 added no tool but grew descriptions, so lean and packs_core already stand over their 1.7.0 + 5 % ceilings.

search.source: plan section 4: idle catalog of a plugin user and the search row, 503 (wire) -> <= 250
search.note: Held on both bases: the 503 the rival compared was the wire payload.
search.measured: 1.8-11, 2026-11-03: 220 tokens prompt payload (922 chars), 230 wire - the three synthetic tools with one-line texts, no output schema, no _meta and no anyOf/additionalProperties noise (DISCOVERY_PINNED empty); flipped to ci

search_pinned.source: plan section 4: search + the default pins <= 1,500
search_pinned.note: Spike S1 measured search + the three proposed pins (cad_batch, drawing_info, entity_list) at 11,437 wire characters, ~2,730 tokens, cad_batch's docstring alone ~1,360. 1.8-11 lists a pin as a shortened card (discovery/serialize.py pinned_card): the same input schema - every property, type, enum, default, bound and the required list - with the description cut to its first paragraph plus 'Full description: describe_tool.' and each parameter description to whole sentences within 250 characters. The registered tool, its full-catalog listing and describe_tool keep the untouched text; nothing a call is validated against changed.
search_pinned.measured: 1.8-11, 2026-11-03: 1,003 tokens prompt payload (4,202 chars), 1,277 wire, 6 tools; the plan's 1,500 holds as measured, flipped to ci

plugin_eval.measured_by: claude plugin eval --no-publish --max-cost-usd (maintainer's machine, never CI); cached/uncached input and time beside the rival's H4 (11 calls, 315k) and H5 (10 calls, 350k)
plugin_eval.measured: 1.8-11, 2026-11-03, one run per case (CLI 2.1.317, --model sonnet, --ablation none, search mode, --max-cost-usd 3, $0.33 + $0.36): layer-cleanup-budget 3 then 6 server calls after the setup (call-budget PASS both runs; one cad_batch of layer_merge + entity_modify_where, then reads); dimension-budget 9 then 12 calls (call-budget FAIL both runs: one dimension_auto(selector) did the job, the excess is the model re-reading the result handle by handle). history-round2 does not exist yet (1.8-10). Stays release: the dimension case is over 6.
